Name: Jerijah, Chief of Hebron
Summary: Chief among the Hebronites, sought in the fortieth year of David's reign.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:31: Chief among the Hebronites, sought in the fortieth year of David's reign.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jerijah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
